options.hot_room_override: Hot room override: At the too-hot temperature every wait is skipped and cooling starts at once.
options.comfort_sync: Comfort sync: Spaces out and softens corrections after a manual change.
options.cool_mode_restore: Cool mode restore: Puts the mode back to cool after a short pause.
options.natural_walkback: Natural walkback: Walks the setpoint back in small, slightly varied steps.
options.touch_signature: Touch signature: Matches nudges to the step size people use on the wall.
options.human_nudge: Human nudge: Snaps follow-up commands to a normal thermostat step.
options.visibility_guard: Visibility guard: Slows down after a touch lands right after a command.
options.routine_timing: Routine timing: Waits for the next tidy clock slot before correcting.
options.comfort_budget: Comfort budget: Caps how many corrections may be sent in a rolling window.
options.command_spacing: Command spacing: Keeps a minimum gap after each command, longer under pressure.
options.low_profile_governor: Low profile governor: Holds safe corrections when the whole exchange has become busy.
options.natural_cadence: Natural cadence: Picks a varied future moment for the next correction.
options.comfort_pace: Comfort pace: Plans a calm moment to answer when people go back and forth a lot.
options.comfort_envelope: Comfort envelope: Lets a small wall preference rest while it stays inside a narrow margin.
options.comfort_compromise: Comfort compromise: Blends a repeated wall choice into a temporary target.
options.comfort_memory: Comfort memory: Learns a small time-of-day bias from repeated safe wall choices.
options.conflict_quiet: Conflict quiet: Stands down during an obvious tug of war.
options.tug_of_war_truce: Tug of war truce: Calls a truce when the setting flips up and down.
options.wall_settling: Wall settling: Waits for someone who is still tapping the wall to stop.
options.manual_comfort_grace: Manual comfort grace: Leaves a manual change alone while the room is comfortable.
options.touch_intent: Touch intent: Extends the grace when recent changes clearly ask for warmer air.
options.cooler_intent_fast_lane: Cooler intent fast lane: When people keep dialing cooler it stops being quiet and cools the room.
options.setpoint_echo: Setpoint echo: Waits for the device to report the last setpoint before sending another.
options.repeat_quiet: Repeat quiet: Waits before sending the same number again.
options.setpoint_stillness: Setpoint stillness: Waits until the wall setting stops moving.
options.sensor_rhythm: Sensor rhythm: Times a correction for just after the usual sensor reading.
options.hvac_alibi: Hvac alibi: Waits for a real change in what the unit is doing.
options.telemetry_alibi: Telemetry alibi: Waits for the next real update from the home.
options.cooling_runway: Cooling runway: Lets a new cooling cycle run before correcting again.
options.room_trend_guard: Room trend guard: Keeps watching while the room is already cooling on its own.
options.thermal_momentum: Thermal momentum: Waits when the room will reach the target soon by itself.
options.weather_drift_timing: Weather drift timing: Holds while the outdoor temperature is stable or falling.
options.website_debounce: Website debounce: Ignores a repeated press of the same control for two minutes.
options.super_defender: Super defender: Answers repeated phone or automation changes without waiting.
options.rival_schedule_watch: Rival schedule watch: Answers the thermostat app's own schedule as a machine, not a person.
options.cool_outdoor_shutdown: Cool outdoor shutdown: Turns the unit off when it is genuinely cool outside, and back on later.
options.siesta_watch: Siesta watch: A timed nap: the unit is parked or turned off until the timer ends.
options.savings_pantry: Savings pantry: Keeps a small balance of saved cooling time for very hot days.
options.desired_state_enforcer: Desired state enforcer: Restores the chosen state when someone other than the owner changes it.
options.remote_settling_guard: Remote settling guard: Gives repeated phone or automation changes a quiet window.
options.peak_power_saver: Peak power saver: Holds extra corrections during peak price or high power use.
options.front_door_guard_post: Front door guard post: Pauses, and can turn the unit off, while a person is detected at the front door.
options.emergency_protocols: Emergency protocols: One-tap stand-down modes for when the room needs to be left alone.
options.cooling_failure_watch: Cooling failure watch: Warns when cooling is wanted but not happening, and turns the unit off only when the room keeps rising.
options.dynamic_cooldown: Dynamic cooldown: A quiet period after a manual change that grows with touch frequency.
options.fan_energy_saver: Fan energy saver: Moves the fan to a saver mode when the room is near the target.
options.upstairs_comfort_guard: Upstairs comfort guard: Cools first when the upstairs rooms are hot and someone is home.
options.schedule_weather_rules: Schedule weather rules: Time-of-day target rules that apply only when the weather allows them.
options.repeated_raise_surrender: Repeated raise surrender: When someone keeps asking for the same number, their number wins for a while.
options.tamper_truce: Tamper truce: Calls a truce when the thermostat vanishes right after an exchange, as if it was detached.
options.wake_up_truce: Wake up truce: A bedroom door opening at dawn means someone is awake, so it agrees on an early number.

pause.name: Pause

hours.name: Hours

climate_missing.title: The device of {title} is missing
climate_missing.description: {title} defends {entity_id}, which does not exist right now. Setup tries again by itself. If the device was removed or renamed, remove this defender and set it up again for the device.

missing_entity.title: A sensor of {title} is missing
missing_entity.description: {title} was set up to read {entity_id}, which does not exist right now. The defender keeps working without it. Choose another sensor in the options of {title}, or restore the sensor.
